qa_pairs.question: What torque should I use for the oil drain plug on all automatic transmission types?
What is the difference in oil drain plug torque between the A4S 270R/A4S 310R and A5S 560Z transmissions?
qa_pairs.answer: The A4S 270R/A4S 310R requires 25 Nm while the A5S 560Z requires 50 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What thread size is used for the oil drain plug on the A5S 440Z transmission?
Which transmission has the highest torque specification for the oil filler plug?
What thread pitch is specified for the A5S 440Z oil filler plug?
How many different torque values are specified for oil drain plugs across all transmission types?
qa_pairs.answer: Five different torque values: 16 Nm, 25 Nm, 30 Nm, 35 Nm, and 50 Nm.
